# Houston Spring Break 2027

> Houston Spring Break 2027 is an independent series of college parties in Houston, Texas, March 10–28, 2027, run as three weeks with party nights Thursday to Sunday of each week. Tickets and Party Packs are sold on Eventbrite. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any college or university.

## Key facts
- Week 1: March 8 – 14, 2027. Parties Thursday, March 11 to Sunday, March 14. Week 1 Party Pack $80 before fees (about $225 bought separately); singles $20–$80. The opening week.
- Week 2: March 15 – 21, 2027. Parties Thursday, March 18 to Sunday, March 21. Week 2 Party Pack $150 before fees (about $285 bought separately); singles $25–$80. The biggest week.
- Week 3: March 22 – 28, 2027. Parties Thursday, March 25 to Sunday, March 28. Week 3 Party Pack $80 before fees (about $225 bought separately); singles $20–$80. The closing week.
- What a Party Pack is: one ticket for every event in one week. The same nights run every week: Thursday: Booze Boat Party w/ Open Bar (21+) and Pretty Nasty; Friday: Brunch + Day Party (21+), Splash City HTX Pool Party and Houston Gone Wild; Saturday: Day Party and Freaknik HTX; Sunday: Day Party (21+) and March Madness (21+). Prices are before Eventbrite fees.
- Ages: 21+ events are the Thursday Booze Boat Party w/ Open Bar, Friday Brunch + Day Party, Sunday Day Party and Sunday March Madness, every week, with a valid government ID. Everything else is 18+.
- Where: Houston, TX. Venue addresses are announced the week of each event and sent to ticket holders and the official GroupMe.
- Refunds: available up to 7 days before the event, under the refund policy on the Eventbrite listing.
- Schools: the official 2027 School List puts 200+ schools on the week that matches their spring break. 25 HBCUs and 19 Texas schools on the list have their own page here.
